junction.about: The mapped southbound D3 mainline (way 149101901, first node 8227650623) begins 13.7 m north of A, where road II/101 crosses the corridor on an existing bridge (way 171863668, bridge=yes, not in the ground network); the declared ways are that bridge’s two approaches. The D0 carriageways lie about 185 m further north. Section 0301 starts at km 0.000 inside this interchange (ŘSD leaflet).
